Shape.Name: Container_ITB
Shape.Text: ITB & Design Basis Review
Check telecom design basis and philosophy
Review specifications and block diagrams
Confirm indoor and outdoor IP ratings
Confirm hazardous area and explosion-proof requirements
Confirm applicable codes, standards, and local regulations
Confirm security regulations (e.g. Saudi HCIS)

Shape.Name: Container_Scope
Shape.Text: Scope, Interfaces, and Existing Systems
Define supply and work scope boundaries
Identify expansion and modification interfaces
Identify tie-in points and physical connections
Check intra-system and inter-system interfaces
Verify existing system capacity and I/O ports
Confirm site survey requirement

Shape.Name: Container_Redundancy
Shape.Text: Redundancy and Reliability Requirements
Verify hot standby and cold standby requirements
Verify failover, load balancing, 1+1, and N+1
Verify cable redundancy and route diversity
Verify SIL-level security requirements
Apply single-system design if no requirement exists

Shape.Name: Container_Defaults
Shape.Text: Default Subsystem Standards (If ITB Is Silent)
Telephone: SIP or H.323
CCTV: IP-based H.264 1080p
PAGA: 100V line and Class C amplifier
Radio: TETRA Release 2
ACS: ISO/IEC 18000-3 (13.56 MHz)
Firewall: NIST 800-41 / IDPS: NIST 800-94

Shape.Name: Container_Systems
Shape.Text: System-Specific Design Requirements
Telephone system design (Analog MDF/IDF or VoIP)
CCTV performance criteria (resolution, IPS, storage)
Outdoor CCTV requirements (sunshade, IP, Ex-proof)
PAGA coverage, zoning (A/B), and monitoring return
Radio coverage, antenna height, and repeaters
ACS door classification and reader application
Data network redundancy and three-level architecture
IDS topology (ring or segmented sub-rings)
